84:
WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT "admfname1" AS first_name, "district"
    FROM "schools"
    WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname1") <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2" AS first_name, "district"
    FROM "schools"
    WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname2") <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname3" AS first_name, "district"
    FROM "schools"
    WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname3") <> ''
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT "first_name", COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY "first_name"
    ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT an."first_name", an."district"
FROM admin_names an
JOIN name_counts nc ON an."first_name" = nc."first_name"
GROUP BY an."first_name", an."district"
ORDER BY an."first_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, an."district" ASC NULLS FIRST

49:
WITH closed_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s."county",
        s."school",
        s."closeddate"
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
      AND s."closeddate" IS NOT NULL
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cs."county",
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM closed_schools cs
    GROUP BY cs."county"
),
top_county AS (
    SELECT cc."county"
    FROM county_counts cc
    ORDER BY cc.cnt DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    cs."school",
    cs."closeddate"
FROM closed_schools cs
JOIN top_county tc ON tc."county" = cs."county"
ORDER BY cs."closeddate" ASC NULLS FIRST;

    FROM frpm f
